description: Returns the p75 of LCP, CLS and INP that real Chrome users had on a URL over the last 28 days, from the Chrome UX Report, with their rating. Falls back to the origin when the URL has no data of its own. Compare it with the lab values of run_snippet: field data is what users get. With weeks, it adds the trend: the p75 of each week, each the 28 days before it, with the change from the first week to the last.

url.description: The page to measure; local development servers (http://localhost:3000) work too

weeks.description: Add the trend of the last 1 to 40 weeks

name: get_crux

history.description: With weeks: scope, weeks, periods, and per metric its p75s, first, last, change in percent and trend

lcpImageShare.description: The share of loads whose LCP is an image, which the sub-parts describe

metrics.description: By metric name: LCP, CLS, INP

navigationTypes.description: The share of each navigation type, such as navigate, reload or back_forward_cache

roundTripTime.description: The p75 of the round trip time of the users, in ms

scope.description: Whether the data is for the URL or for its whole origin

subParts.description: The p75 of the sub-parts of an image LCP: ttfb, resourceLoadDelay, resourceLoadTime, elementRenderDelay

unavailable.description: Why there is no field data, such as a page with too little traffic

title: Get CrUX field data
